components_created.name: PipelineVisualization
components_created.description: Horizontal stage flow display with animated progress bars, click-to-view details, and real-time updates
features: Displays all 5 pipeline stages in order: markdown-conversion → chunker → fact-generator → ingestor
Status colors: pending (gray), running (blue), completed (green), failed (red), skipped (yellow)
Animated progress bars between stages during processing
Retry and skip buttons for failed stages
Full accessibility support with ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation

components_created.name: StageIndicator
components_created.description: Individual stage display component with status indicators and action buttons
features: Expandable error details for failed stages
Retry button for retryable failed stages
Skip button for optional failed stages
